title: fix(metadata-protocol): the cached /meta item read answers the item's own change time as Last-Modified, never the read time
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XKQgHXwRFWSGUn8kEwFcvFL)_

Fixes #31196

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:元数据按名读取的缓存出口(默认的 `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name`)里,`Last-Modified` 不再填「这次读取的时间」。条目来自 `sys_metadata` 存储行时,填该行的 `updated_at`(最近一次保存或发布的时间);条目来自代码或文件、平台不知道它何时改过时,不发这个头。
- 为什么改:同一条没改过的元数据,两次读到的 `Last-Modified` 不一样而 ETag 相同,这个头在说假话,还让 #31171 的测试在合并队列里抖过两次。
- 风险与回滚:只改头的取值;ETag、`Cache-Control: private, no-cache`、`If-None-Match` 的 304 全部不变,按名读取的响应信封逐字节不变(时间走进程内不可序列化的符号,不进 JSON)。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`(采用存储行处记下 `updated_at`,返回信封时挂上);`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-search-and-cache.ts`(`lastModified` 改读它,没有就不给键);新文件 `served-row-changed-at.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.cached-item-last-modified.test.ts`,预期 4 个用例全过:两次读同一个时间、保存和发布各自推进它、代码条目没有 `lastModified` 键。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `getMetaItemCached` (`protocol-search-and-cache.ts`) answered `lastModified: new Date().toISOString()`, the time of the read. It now answers the change time of the stored `sys_metadata` row the item is served from, and no `lastModified` key when no stored row serves it. The REST door already renders `Last-Modified` only when the key is present (`meta-item-read-routes.ts`, unchanged), so a code-shipped item answers no header.
- The time is known in one place: the by-name read (`readMetaItem`, `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`) holds the row it adopts as the item's content. It records `canonicalIsoInstant(row.updated_at ?? row.created_at)` on its active-state envelope as a non-enumerable `Symbol.for` key (`served-row-changed-at.ts`, the `stored-row-binding.ts` pattern). `JSON.stringify` drops it and a spread does not copy it, so the published `GetMetaItemResponseSchema` envelope, its REST and MCP answers, and every `toEqual` pin are unchanged. The cached read asks `servedRowChangedAtOf(result)`.
- `canonicalIsoInstant` in `sys-metadata-repository.ts` is now exported (module-internal; `index.ts` does not re-export it), so the read uses the repository's one spelling of a driver timestamp.
- Changeset `.changeset/31196-cached-meta-item-last-modified.md`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch. `@objectstack/rest` gains a test only.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.cached-item-last-modified.test.ts` (real protocol, stub `sys_metadata` store, fake `Date` moved minutes between steps):
  - §1 two reads of one unchanged stored item (5 and 9 minutes after the save) both answer the save time; CONTROL: same ETag, `cacheControl` `['private','no-cache']`.
  - §2 a save moves it to the save time; a pending draft does not move it; a publish moves it to the publish time; CONTROL: each change also moves the ETag.
  - §3 a code-shipped item (registry, no stored row) has no `lastModified` key; CONTROL: it keeps its ETag and `cacheControl`.
  - §4 the change time is not in the by-name read's serialised envelope.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-cached-last-modified.test.ts` (the door, protocol double): renders the protocol's time as `Sat, 07 Nov 2026 08:00:00 GMT` and the same on a second read; sends no `Last-Modified` when the key is absent while ETag and `Cache-Control` stay; `If-Modified-Since` answers 200 with the body, with or without a time.

Ablation (os-dev, via `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the test resolves the protocol from `src/`): anchor `...(lastModified !== undefined ? { lastModified } : {}),` replaced by `lastModified: new Date().toISOString(),` (anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob c29eebfc → c033ddc6), then the pin file:

<details><summary>Ablation red: 3 failed | 1 passed (§4 stays green, as predicted: it reads the by-name envelope, not the cached answer)</summary>

```
 ❯ src/protocol.cached-item-last-modified.test.ts (4 tests | 3 failed) 82ms
     × §1 two reads of one unchanged stored item answer the same lastModified — the save time 48ms
     × §2 a save moves it, and so does a publish 26ms
     × §3 an item no stored row serves has no known change time: no lastModified key 4ms
AssertionError: expected '2026-11-07T08:05:00.000Z' to be '2026-11-07T08:00:00.000Z' // Object.is equality
AssertionError: expected [ Array(5) ] to not include 'lastModified'
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (c29eebfc85db) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Mechanism, measured on `origin/main` 66bf5b4a.** The order's hypothesis holds: the producer stamped the read time and the REST door only rendered it. The door needed no change.
- **Where the change time is reachable.** Not at `getMetaItemCached`: its only input is `getMetaItem`'s envelope, whose `version` is a hash digest of the stored head (`readVersionToken` → `receiptVersion`), not a time. The row is in hand inside `readMetaItem`, so the file surface grew past the claim's by `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`, the new `served-row-changed-at.ts`, a one-word `export` in `sys-metadata-repository.ts`, and the engine-double ledger row for the new test (`scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`, written by `check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write`).
- **What counts as the item's change time.** The adopted row's `updated_at`, which `SysMetadataRepository` stamps on every write of the row, a save and a publish alike (§2 measures both), `created_at` for a row without one. A stored row the read declines (a shipped flow name's row, ADR-0146 D9) does not lend its time: the served item is then the code's, and answers none.
- **Boundary, stated rather than hidden.** A stored object's served body also carries code-side contributions folded at read time (`extend` fields from installed packages, the artifact's lock envelope). Installing a package that changes them moves the ETag but not this `Last-Modified`, which states the stored row's change as the card's ruling names it. Nothing judges freshness from it: the ETag does (`no-cache`).
- **`If-Modified-Since`, measured.** The door forwards it as `cacheRequest.ifModifiedSince`; the protocol never reads that member, and the door's own 304 compares `If-None-Match` only. So no request is answered 304 from a time, before or after this change; the REST pin records it.
- **Precision.** `Last-Modified` is whole seconds (`toUTCString()`), so two writes within one second share a header value; the ETag still separates them.
- **Not touched, carrier: seat.** `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts` (PR #31195) masks `last-modified` with a comment saying the protocol stamps the read time. After this PR that sentence is false for `Last-Modified` (the `Date` header half still holds); the masking itself stays harmless. Outside the claimed surface.

## Verification

Head `7ff2b9e5`. `origin/main` was merged once before the PR, a no-op at 66bf5b4a; main has since moved to 30f23fef, and none of its 141 changed files is one this PR touches (one other `packages/metadata-protocol` test file).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` (on f59f3fac+565bea38; the two later commits change only the two new test files and the ledger row, and both pin files were re-run green on 7ff2b9e5: 4/4 and 3/3): Test Files 323 passed | 4 skipped (327), Tests 22531 passed | 26 skipped (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: Test Files 394 passed (394), Tests 7489 passed | 332 skipped (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0 (metadata-protocol's `tsc` includes `src/**/*`, the new test listed by `--listFiles`; rest runs `check:test-typecheck`, 0 errors).
- Lint, scoped: `node --stack-size=4000 node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js packages/metadata-protocol packages/rest --no-inline-config`, exit 0.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` named 69 families for this diff; all 69 ran on `7ff2b9e5`, exit 0 each. `--ran`: "69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876` on this shallow clone first.
